description: Full detail for one bigiron.com lot by its URL slug: description, sale status, bid count, make/model/year, seller, location, category and (for active lots) current bid / Buy-It-Now price. Slugs come from bigiron_search or bigiron_sold_search result urls (the part after /Lots/). Bids are served through a 5-minute result cache, so the current bid can be up to five minutes old: near the close of an auction treat it as a lower bound, never as the final price. Sourced from bigiron.com/Lots/{slug}.
name: bigiron_lot_detail
